hook: Strangers became enemies in one week. Here's how.
facts: In *1954*, Muzafer Sherif took *22* boys to a camp in Oklahoma.
He split them into two teams and made them compete for prizes.
Within days, the teams were name-calling and *raiding* each other's cabins.
Then came shared problems, like a broken water supply. Teamwork *melted* the hostility.
title: Psychology Facts
